scripts.build: npm run build -w apps/tecnico && npm run build -w apps/admin
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w packages/shared && npm run typecheck -w apps/tecnico && npm run typecheck -w apps/admin
scripts.dev:tecnico:celular: cross-env DEV_HTTPS=1 npm run dev -w apps/tecnico
scripts.dev:admin:celular: cross-env DEV_HTTPS=1 npm run dev -w apps/admin
